summary: Iteration 15: Full E2E verification of (1) Vendor Brand Approval Queue, (2) Solar Package Presets + approval, (3) Customer 1-tap Package on public /solar, (4) Freelancer Live Enquiry polling + unread badge + mark-read, plus regression of existing Solar EPC brand catalog. Backend pytest 7/7 GREEN in /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_approval.py (vendor brand pending→hidden→admin approve→public visible; reject empty reason=422; reject with reason persists to rejection_reason; vendor approve=403; admin package auto-approved+public visible; vendor package pending→hidden→admin approve→public visible; customer /packages/manage=403; freelancer enquiry unread flag & mark-read). Frontend Playwright: (a) Admin UI: Administration → Solar Brands (rbac-tab-solar) → Brands & Prices + Package Presets sub-tabs render; brand-filter-all/pending buttons work (pending count reflected as 'Pending approval (2)'). (b) Vendor added two brands via UI (QA Pending Inv UI @₹5,200 and QA Reject Bat UI @₹31,000) — both showed 'pending review' via data-testid=brand-status-<id> and neither appeared on public /solar dropdowns. (c) Admin approved the inverter (brand-approve-<id>) and rejected the battery via brand-reject-<id> (window.prompt dialog was answered with 'Not approved for catalog'). After the action, statuses became 'approved' and 'rejected'; the vendor UI showed the rejected brand row with 'rejected' and reason 'Not approved for catalog'. Approved brand appeared in the public /solar inverter dropdown (option count went 4→5, confirming visibility). (d) Public /solar 'Ready-made packages (1-tap)': solar-packages section renders both Value Home and Premium Home. Clicking pkg-pick-<id> for Premium Home filled all brand-sel-* selects (module=Waaree, inverter=Sungrow, structure=Tata Anodized, protection=Schneider). Generate EPC estimate produced BOQ with expected brand rows (Waaree TOPCon Bifacial for module). pkg-clear reset every brand-sel-* to empty. (e) Admin created a package via UI (pkg-name/pkg-tier/pkg-sel-module/pkg-save) → row appeared with 'approved' status immediately. (f) Vendor Package Presets UI blocks package creation until the vendor has their own brands: message 'Add some brands first, then bundle them into a package.' (no pkg-sel-* rendered) — this pending→approve path is covered by the backend pytest instead. (g) Freelancer live-enquiry: architect@buildecogroup.com logs into Freelancer Workspace (freelancer-profile-banner renders); nav-enquiries visible. Posting POST /api/freelancers/user_101810beb884/enquiry as customer caused the nav-badge-enquiries (value '1') to appear on architect UI in <1s (well within the 15s poll). Clicking nav-enquiries shows the received enquiries with the new message and clears the unread badge; subsequent GET /freelancers/me/enquiries returns unread=0.

integration_issues.issue: Race condition: when a new enquiry lands right around the poll interval, the Enquiries table sometimes renders a stale snapshot missing the just-created enquiry (e.g., 'QA_POLL_TEST_MSG_XYZ' not in the visible rows even though it was persisted). The badge/unread counter itself is correct. Consider re-fetching /freelancers/me/enquiries when the Enquiries tab is opened (not only on nav switch) or invalidating the local cache before rendering.

issues: When the vendor has zero brands, the create form hides all pkg-sel-* selects with only the helper text 'Add some brands first…'. This is intentional but means the vendor cannot bundle admin-seeded brands into a package — a small UX friction. Consider allowing the vendor to bundle any approved brand (their own + public) so they can build packages against the shared catalog.

action_items: (Minor) In FreelancerWorkspace, re-fetch enquiries when clicking the Enquiries nav so the list is guaranteed fresh (avoid the observed stale-render race).
(Minor UX) Allow vendors to include approved public brands in their package presets, not just their own — otherwise a vendor with no brands cannot create any package.
critical_code_review_comments: solar_epc.py POST /brands/{id}/reject correctly returns 422 on empty reason and persists rejection_reason on the doc (verified via /brands/manage). Response body only returns {ok,status}; consider echoing rejection_reason for consumer convenience.

solar_epc.py create_package sets status='approved' iff super_admin — matches spec. _expand_selections returns available=false when the underlying brand is not approved+active, which is correct for hiding un-approved bundle items.
phase3a.py freelancer enquiries endpoint returns {received, sent, unread} — matches contract. mark-read POST correctly flips is_read for the caller's received enquiries.
SolarBrandsManager uses window.prompt for reject reason — matches spec but not accessible; consider a shadcn Dialog for consistency.
SolarPackagesManager (vendor) hides the picker until vendor has ≥1 brand — see UX action item above.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all critical flows verified; only a minor stale-list race on the enquiries page
